content: LAN-exposure pitfalls for a localhost FastAPI service: default bind 127.0.0.1; switching to 0.0.0.0 is itself a security decision - pair with fail-closed header-token auth (APIKeyHeader/Bearer via a router-level dependency, hmac.compare_digest), never tokens in URLs/query/bodies (leak via logs, referer, history). CORS: allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is a known high-severity misconfiguration; for non-browser clients (load balancer, scripts) CORS is irrelevant - do not add CORSMiddleware unless a browser client exists. Secret-file pattern (gitignored data/*.txt, env first) already used in this repo fits fine for an API key. Bind 127.0.0.1 unless a real LB/remote consumer exists; the PROJECT.md mentions LB probing - verify whether that LB is local (e.g., local reverse proxy) before binding wider.
